features: TIME SAVING: Just 1 pair of scissors but installed 5 pairs of blades working at the same time, makes chopping easier and much more efficient than a knife or single blade scissors. Sharp blades make fast leaves snipping rather than crushing or messing. No flavor losing of ingredients.5-blade herb shear set is equivalent to 10 knife chops, which can snip fresh herbs, basils, or chives in perfect size onto plates quickly.

UNIQUE DESIGN: Our herb scissor adopts ergonomic curve design in shape, which is suitable for the natural form of the human body, reducing the fatigue caused by using scissors, provides comfortable and good grip for cutting, chopping or mincing

PREMIUM MATERIALS :With quality stainless steel construction, five 3-inch blades and an ergonomic TPR handle that won't slip, you're in complete control.Herb scissors is ergonomically designed, soft touch, light weight, anti-abrasive. Better than silicone, the TPR interior handle provides a comfortable, soft grip.

EASY TO CLEAN: Dishwasher Safe. This 5-blade scissors very easy to clean. To wash the kitchen herb scissors, just swipe with the cleaning cover to the end of the blades, rinse the blades, or put them in your dishwasher and get ready for next use.

VERSATILE : The multifunctional 5 blades herb chopper can be used for shredding and chopping fresh mint, rosemary, sage, cilantro, parsley, basil, chives seaweed, even bread, noodle, beef jerky etc. Great for cutting paper, too.Some customer also use it for cutting paper & cloth for art& crafts design or shred old bill and useless mail, It’s an essential gadget in your daily life.
